title: Magic Knights: earning stars (missions and conduct)
text: Gold stars come from three places. 1) Questline advancements of this mod pay automatically, once each: a task gives 1 star, a goal 2, a challenge 5. 2) The Mission Board: /multiverse mission shows three offers a day (a day is 20 real minutes), harder as your rank grows. Use /multiverse mission take 1 (or 2, 3) to accept, status to check, abandon to drop it without penalty. Your own kills count by themselves; one mission at a time, a time limit of 30 minutes, five missions a day. 3) The Star Awards Festival, see Squads. Gold stars also give your grimoire mastery. Black stars are conduct: killing a villager or a wandering trader gives 1 black star, killing a member of your own squad gives 2, at most once a minute. A Magic Knight protects the people.
